parameters.name: ServiceCode
parameters.description:
The service type. Valid values:
- **antcloudauth**: financial-grade ID Verification.
- **cloudauthst** (discontinued): ID Verification enhanced edition.

parameters.name: TimeRange
parameters.description: The time range. The search range is the previous N days. Format: a numeric string. Unit: days (d). A value of 1 indicates the previous 1 day.
